courses.title: Biology Courses
courses.intro: Our programmes are built for Cambridge exam success — not generic lessons. Every class is examiner-aligned, with checked work, feedback, and progress tracking.
courses.cta_text: **Want checked copies, personalised feedback, and progress tracking?** Start with the *free resources*, then move into the guided batch for structure, accountability, and examiner-style training.

items.title: O Level Biology (5090)
items.desc: A structured, rubric-driven programme for Cambridge O Level Biology. Students learn **exam-style answer writing, data handling, and logical response building** through targeted past paper practice and examiner-aligned drills.

items.title: IGCSE Biology (0610)
items.desc: A clarity-focused programme for Cambridge IGCSE Biology. We strengthen learning through **diagram-based explanations, experimental practice,** and rubric-aligned worksheets with feedback.

items.title: AS Level Biology (9700)
items.desc: An advanced foundation programme for Cambridge AS Biology. Students sharpen structured **answer writing, data interpretation, and exam logic** through timed practice, examiner reports, and rubric-driven drills.

items.title: A2 Level Biology (9700)
items.desc: An advanced evaluation programme for Cambridge A2 Biology. Students master **critical analysis, planning experiments, and writing examiner-style responses** with mentorship, mock exams, and targeted feedback to reach A*/A.
